venues.address: Rua do Grilo, 119, Beato Innovation District

evidence.note: Official Casa Capitão website (Beato, Lisboa cultural space — concerts, exhibitions, artistic residencies) states its own address: 'Rua do Grilo, 119, Beato Innovation District'. No postal code was found on the fetched page within this task's bounded search, so none is fabricated here; secondary (non-first-party) sources disagree on the exact postcode digits (1950-142/144/146 variously reported), which is exactly why this project does not treat them as address authority.

LISBON-PORTO-VENUE-ESTATE-01: official homepage states the club's own address 'Praça da Alegria, 48, 1250-004 Lisboa' (distinct from its jazz school address, 'Travessa da Galé 36, 1º, 1300-263 Lisboa', also on the same page but not used here). No coordinates, embedded map, or outbound map link with coordinate data was found within this task's bounded search. Oldest jazz club in Portugal, founded 1948; already a TECHNICAL_PATH_PROVEN P1 source in sources/lisbon.json (id hot-clube-de-portugal) but had no canonical Venue entry prior to this package.

LISBON-PORTO-VENUE-ESTATE-01: official contacts page states 'Rua da Barroca nº 59, 1200-047 Lisboa, Portugal' for the main Bairro Alto space (a second, distinct 'ZDB 8 MARVILA' location at 'Praça David Leandro da Silva 2, 1950-131 Lisboa' is also listed but not admitted here — a separate physical room, not merged in). Nonprofit art/experimental-music centre since 1994; already a P1 DISCOVERED source in sources/lisbon.json (id galeria-ze-dos-bois).
